name: vector-search-agent-typescript
description: AI agent with vector search on Azure DocumentDB (TypeScript)

scripts.auth: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js auth
scripts.upload: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js upload
scripts.start: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js agent
scripts.cleanup: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js cleanup
scripts.test:live: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js live
